name: the-another-seo
description: Performance-first SEO for WordPress at catalog scale.
author: The Another

scripts.build: wp-scripts build blocks/breadcrumbs/index.js --output-path=dist/breadcrumbs && wp-scripts build assets/src/settings/index.js --output-path=dist/settings && wp-scripts build assets/src/media-picker/index.js --output-path=dist/media-picker
scripts.plugin-zip: composer build && npm run build && sh scripts/dist-archive.sh && node scripts/version-zip.js
scripts.plugin-zip:check: composer build && npm run build && sh scripts/dist-archive.sh && node scripts/version-zip.js --label=test
